create_qre_solver: create a QRE solver instance with configurable temperature, learning rates, and projection mode
init_solver_vars: initialize solver variables for a game with a given number of players and strategies
compute_qre_gradients: compute exploitability gradients and regularized exploitability estimates for a game
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent update step on QRE solver parameters
run_euclidean_descent_step: run projected Euclidean gradient descent update step on QRE solver parameters
compute_qre_exploitability: compute Tsallis entropy regularized exploitability for current policy distribution
record_aux_errors: record auxiliary variable gradient norms during solver training
